question: Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only A is kept above F. Only C is kept between F and D. Only B is kept below E. How many boxes are kept between E and F?
solution:
Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only A is kept above F.
 
• Only C is kept between F and D.
 
• Only B is kept below E

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
A
